result.summary: The page layout appears intact overall: cards, badges, banner, icons, and bottom navigation are aligned and render correctly. The only clipping (category chips, the last carousel card, and the bottom pop-up card) falls under the allowed scrolling/viewport exceptions. Two minor issues were found: a likely spelling error in the search placeholder and a time badge overlapping a food image.

issues.description: The search placeholder text appears to read 'Restarants, dishes, groceries', which looks like a misspelling of 'Restaurants'.
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder text to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.

issues.description: The '15–25 min' delivery-time badge on the Green Bowl Poké card overlaps the left part of the food photo, partly covering the dish.
issues.suggestion: Move the badge to a corner with consistent padding, or crop the image so the main food subject stays unobstructed.
